units.summary: Adds an unexported onStatus callback field to statusRecorder. It does nothing until WriteHeader invokes it, so the field alone is low risk.
units.headline: statusRecorder gains an optional onStatus callback field
units.reason: Unexported field, nil by default, and only the WriteHeader and serveThroughBreaker changes make it matter.

units.summary: WriteHeader now calls onStatus with the first final status (>=200 or 101) before forwarding it. This is what lets the breaker outcome be reported when headers are written instead of when the handler returns.
units.headline: WriteHeader reports final status to onStatus callback
units.reason: Runs breaker accounting inline on the response write path, so a reviewer must judge ordering and repeat calls.
focus: callback runs before the underlying WriteHeader, and the once guard in serveThroughBreaker covers repeated WriteHeader calls
implicit 200 via Write reaches WriteHeader, so onStatus still fires

units.summary: Introduces a type alias for gobreaker's two-step breaker, used wherever the per-group breaker is held. The alias is what moves the whole package onto the two-step API.
units.headline: Add groupBreaker alias for two-step circuit breaker
units.reason: A type alias adds no behavior; the real change is in newGroupBreaker and serveThroughBreaker.

units.summary: The per-group breaker is now built with NewTwoStepCircuitBreaker, with the same settings. This changes how callers must report outcomes (Allow/done instead of Execute).
units.headline: newGroupBreaker builds a two-step circuit breaker
units.reason: Changes the breaker's calling contract, so every user must report outcomes or hold half-open slots forever.
focus: every caller of the breaker (including the ST fallback) now calls done exactly once
IsExcluded still applies to outcomes passed to done

units.summary: Replaces cb.Execute with Allow plus a done callback guarded by sync.Once. The outcome is reported at the first final status write, with a deferred fallback and panic handling, so a long watch no longer holds a half-open trial slot.
units.headline: Breaker outcome now reported when status is written, not on return
units.reason: Rewrites breaker accounting, concurrency (sync.Once) and panic handling on the main proxy path.
focus: a backend that returns 200 and then fails mid-body is now counted as success
the panic path re-panics and still reports exactly one outcome
a handler that writes nothing reports rec.status 0 through breakerOutcome
a request that is not allowed returns 503 before withProxyFailure

units.summary: Test helper signature changes to take the groupBreaker alias. No assertions change.
units.headline: Test helper takes groupBreaker type
units.reason: Test-only type update to follow the production type change.

units.summary: Test now builds a two-step breaker to match the production type. Assertions are unchanged.
units.headline: Half-open cap test uses two-step breaker
units.reason: Test-only constructor swap, with no assertion removed or loosened.

units.summary: The helper trips the breaker through Allow and done instead of Execute. If Allow fails, it silently does nothing.
units.headline: tripBreaker uses Allow/done to force a failure
units.reason: Test-only helper updated for the two-step API with equivalent effect.
